post.description:
Prices the lines against the catalog, gives the order the branch's
next ticket number, computes the due time from the turnaround tier
and working hours, and tags every piece. Send an `Idempotency-Key`
header so that a retried request returns the same order (200)
instead of creating a second one (201).

put.description:
Only before any work has started (status `received`). Fails with 409
`order_version_conflict` when the order changed since `version`, and
`order_not_editable` once it is in process. Pieces are tagged again.

post.description:
Runs the same pricing as taking the order in, without saving
anything, so the counter can show the total and due time while the
order is being put together. Amounts are whole rials.

Allowed moves are listed in the order's `available_transitions`.
Marking it `ready` marks its pieces ready and can record where it is
kept (`rack_location`); cancelling needs `orders.cancel` and a reason,
and fails with 409 `order_has_payments` while payments are recorded.

get.description:
Every priced item × service pair of the default price list, in
whole rials per unit. A missing pair means the service is not
offered for that item.

put.description:
Changes only the listed cells; send `price: null` to remove one.
Returns the whole matrix afterwards.

SaveCustomerRequest.description:
Creates (POST) or updates (PUT) a customer together with their
addresses. On update, the addresses sent replace the stored ones:
entries with an id are kept and changed, the rest are added, and
addresses left out are removed.
